item.name: The Reception
item.accessCondition: The starting room of a Hotel run.
item.purpose: Gives the run its first safe-looking stop before the numbered doors begin.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Search the room's drawers and furniture for ordinary early-run supplies.
item.hazardsOrEntities: No named set-piece encounter is tied to the starting room.
item.survivalTip: Collect the first useful supplies, then move on instead of spending too long in the lobby.
item.cardSummary: The Hotel starting room. Grab early supplies here, then open Door 1 and begin the main route.

item.name: The Library
item.accessCondition: Reach the middle of the Hotel route and open the Library entrance.
item.purpose: Solve the book puzzle and unlock the next door while Figure patrols the room.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Find the books and solution information, then use their symbols to solve the lock.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Figure is the main threat. Rush, Ambush, Dread, and other encounters can add pressure depending on the run.
item.survivalTip: Crouch and keep your movement quiet. Use the room's furniture to route around Figure while you finish the code.
item.relatedItems: Library books, solution paper, hiding spots, Crucifix
item.cardSummary: The first major Hotel puzzle. Find the books, stay quiet around Figure, and use the symbols to open the lock.

item.name: Jeff Shop (The Hotel)
item.route: Shortly after The Library, commonly around Doors 53-59
item.accessCondition: Continue past The Library during a Hotel run.
item.purpose: A mid-run shop where Jeff sells utility items and accepts tips.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Spend Gold on useful healing, light, and survival items before the late Hotel rooms.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Jeff, El Goblino, and Bob are friendly shop residents. Normal run threats can still matter before or after the stop.
item.survivalTip: Use the shop to cover the weakness in your current loadout instead of buying duplicates you already have.
item.relatedItems: Gold, Flashlight, Lighter, Vitamins, Lockpick, Skeleton Key, Crucifix
item.cardSummary: The Hotel's mid-run supply stop. Spend Gold on the one utility item your run is missing most.

item.name: The Rooms Entrance
item.accessCondition: Find the Basement lever, then unlock the chained A-000 entrance with two Lockpicks and a Skeleton Key.
item.purpose: Connects the Hotel to The Rooms subfloor.
item.puzzleOrLoot: The Basement lever opens the gate, while Lockpicks and a Skeleton Key open the final entrance.
item.hazardsOrEntities: The route passes through a dark Basement where time and navigation can become the real problem.
item.survivalTip: Only commit when you have the required keys and enough light to search the Basement for its lever.
item.cardSummary: The hidden Door 60 route into The Rooms. Bring the keys first, then search the Basement for the lever.

item.name: The Infirmary
item.accessCondition: Reach the mid-to-late Hotel route, or return from a Rooms exit.
item.purpose: Provides a named medical stop and an optional Skeleton Key side route.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Check the room for healing supplies and the skull-locked route connected to the Herb of Viridis.
item.hazardsOrEntities: The room is part of the active Hotel route, so passing entities can still make a slow search dangerous.
item.survivalTip: Search with a purpose, then leave. Do not burn a Skeleton Key here unless the side-room reward fits the run.
item.relatedItems: Skeleton Key, Herb of Viridis, healing items
item.cardSummary: A useful Hotel checkpoint for healing and the skull-lock side route. Search quickly, then keep the run moving.

item.name: The Courtyard
item.route: Late Hotel route before The Greenhouse
item.accessCondition: Reach the late Hotel rooms and follow the route toward the garden section.
item.purpose: Moves the run through an outdoor Hotel area and provides the useful Shears route.
item.puzzleOrLoot: A small toolshed can provide Shears, which are useful for vine-covered chests and passages.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Rain and the open layout make it easier to lose time while searching for the next entrance.
item.survivalTip: If you plan to enter The Outdoors, check the Courtyard toolshed for Shears before moving on.
item.cardSummary: The Hotel's outdoor transition. Check the toolshed for Shears before the route pushes you toward the Greenhouse.

item.name: The Greenhouse
item.accessCondition: Reach the final Hotel section through the Courtyard route.
item.purpose: Carries the run through a dark garden section before the Electrical Room and the late-game routes.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Advance through the numbered rooms while checking the dark garden for supplies and vine-covered paths.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Rush, Snare, Eyes, Screech, Hide, and other threats are harder to read when the lights are out. Lightning can also mask audio cues.
item.survivalTip: Carry a light source and listen carefully. In the dark rooms, Rush's approach sound matters more than a light flicker.
item.cardSummary: The Hotel's dark garden stretch. Keep a light ready and listen for Rush when the usual warning flicker disappears.

item.name: The Electrical Room
item.accessCondition: Reach the end of The Hotel and open the gated room with its lever and Electrical Room Key route.
item.purpose: Solve the breaker puzzle, survive Figure's chase, and finish the Hotel.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Find the breaker switches, restore power, and use the lower-floor Rift before taking the elevator out.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Figure patrols the tall room while the gates and multiple levels make navigation slow.
item.survivalTip: Search every level for switches and the Electrical Room Key, then leave as soon as the breaker puzzle is complete.
item.relatedItems: Electrical Room Key, Rift, Lockpick, Crucifix
item.cardSummary: The Hotel finale. Find the switches, finish the breaker puzzle, and escape Figure before taking the elevator.

item.name: The Adit
item.route: Immediately after the Hotel elevator crash, around Door 100.5
item.accessCondition: Enter The Mines from the Hotel elevator route.
item.purpose: Introduces the Mines route and sends the run into its minecart and cave sections.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Follow the entry path and collect early Mines supplies before the route opens into larger rooms.
item.hazardsOrEntities: The Mines introduce darker rooms, water, minecart routes, and new encounter patterns.
item.survivalTip: Treat the Adit as a resupply point. Keep a light source ready before the Mines rooms become harder to read.
item.cardSummary: The first named stop in The Mines. Use it to reset your bearings and prepare for the darker route ahead.

item.name: The Bridges
item.accessCondition: Progress through the ordinary Mines rooms until the bridge encounter appears.
item.purpose: Cross three bridge sections while Halt and the broken paths pressure the player.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Choose the one usable bridge in each section and reach the staircase at the far end.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Halt, broken bridges, darkness, and falls into the lower area.
item.survivalTip: Bring a light source. The correct bridge has a set of drawers on the right side of the walkway.
item.cardSummary: A three-part bridge puzzle in The Mines. Keep a light on and check the drawers beside the safe path.

item.name: The Caverns
item.accessCondition: Reach the first Mines Seek chase after the earlier cave rooms.
item.purpose: Runs the player through broken bridges and a minecart chase into The Nest.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Jump the broken bridges, then steer the minecart through the correct tracks and obstacles.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Seek, falling boulders, Stalagmite pits, minecart barriers, and wrong-track dead ends.
item.survivalTip: Follow Guiding Light's path. Steer only when the tracks split and crouch for low barriers.
item.relatedItems: Guiding Light and the minecart route
item.cardSummary: The first Mines Seek chase. Follow the blue route, clear the jumps, and steer the minecart into The Nest.

item.name: The Nest
item.accessCondition: Complete The Caverns and enter the Grumble nest.
item.purpose: Power the Anchors and escape the nest while Grumbles patrol the tunnels.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Find the Anchors, enter their number sequences, and open the exit before the room closes in.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Grumble, Queen Grumble, darkness, and narrow routes around the nest.
item.survivalTip: Learn the layout, keep a light ready, and use tight corners or hiding spots when a Grumble gets close.
item.cardSummary: The Mines' nest puzzle and chase. Find the Anchors quickly, then escape the Grumbles through the correct route.

item.name: Jeff Shop (The Mines)
item.route: After The Nest, in the Sewers around the 152-162 range
item.accessCondition: Continue through the early Sewers after escaping The Nest.
item.purpose: Provides a second floor-specific shop stop for light, healing, and Mines utility items.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Spend Gold on items that help with the dark Sewers, minecart puzzles, and later boss rooms.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Jeff, El Goblino, and Bob are friendly. The surrounding Sewers still contain ordinary Mines hazards.
item.survivalTip: Treat this as a loadout check. Buy light or healing support before committing to the long Sewer stretch.
item.relatedItems: Gold, Bulklight, Bandage Pack, Battery Pack, Shears, Multitool, Crucifix
item.cardSummary: The Mines' supply stop. Its route placement differs from the Hotel shop, so use the Mine-specific stock to prepare for the Sewers.

item.name: The Railway Station
item.route: The Sewers, commonly somewhere in the 153-199 range, but not guaranteed
item.accessCondition: Encounter the named station room during the Sewer route.
item.purpose: Uses minecarts and tracks to open the blocked exit from a two-level station.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Move the carts, pull the distant lever, and use the cart to break the wooden barrier at the exit.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Minecart timing, floods, and a possible Dupe door on the wrong platform.
item.survivalTip: The real exit is behind the wooden barrier. Check the door number before entering a platform door.
item.cardSummary: A high-chance but non-guaranteed Sewer puzzle room. Move the minecarts carefully and use the barred exit as your landmark.

item.name: The Sewage Pipes
item.accessCondition: Reach the second Mines Seek chase in the Sewers.
item.purpose: Carries the run through flooded corridors, split paths, and grate tunnels toward The Dam.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Follow Guiding Light and break through the grate doors to stay ahead of the chase.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Seek, Queen Grumble, floods, boulders, and blocked sewer grates.
item.survivalTip: Stay with the blue current and interact repeatedly at grate doors so the chase does not catch you.
item.cardSummary: The second Mines Seek chase. Follow the blue current, break the grates, and do not stop in the flooded tunnels.

item.name: The Dam
item.accessCondition: Reach the end of the Mines after the Sewer route.
item.purpose: Defeat Dam Seek and open the route into The Woods.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Turn the valves through three phases, lower the liquid, and activate the generator gate.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Dam Seek, Seek Hands, Seek Sludge, Seek Worm, rising liquid, and exposed platforms.
item.survivalTip: Stay on solid ground, turn valves between attacks, and never treat the black liquid as a shortcut.
item.cardSummary: The Mines finale. Lower the reservoir in phases, avoid the Seek attacks, and open the gate to The Woods.

item.name: The Woods
item.accessCondition: Complete The Dam and climb into the outdoor transition.
item.purpose: Closes the current Mines run and leads to the castle door beyond the released route.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Follow the path to the ending door and use the Rifts found along the transition when available.
item.hazardsOrEntities: The ending sequence features Queen Grumble and Seek. The castle door beyond the woods is outside this collection.
item.survivalTip: Keep moving along the path and treat the castle door as the current endpoint rather than a playable route in this collection.
item.cardSummary: The released endpoint after The Dam. Walk the forest transition, then stop at the current route boundary.

item.name: The Rear Entryway
item.accessCondition: Enter The Backdoor through its current Lobby route.
item.purpose: Starts the Backdoor run and gives the player time to find the first key.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Crouch behind the fenced corner and collect the Room Key that opens the path to Room -50.
item.hazardsOrEntities: The timer does not start until the door to Room -50 opens, making this the calmest Backdoor search room.
item.survivalTip: Search carefully before opening the next door. Use the free time to find the key and orient yourself.
item.cardSummary: The Backdoor starting room. Find the key behind the fence before the timer pressure begins.

item.name: The Vestibule
item.accessCondition: Reach the final Backdoor room before the exit.
item.purpose: Provides the final timer lever, Starlight purchase, and exit route.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Pull the Timer Lever when needed and use Gold to buy the Bottle of Starlight on its pedestal.
item.hazardsOrEntities: The Backdoor timer and its Haste/Blitz pressure make the route outside the room time-sensitive.
item.survivalTip: Handle the lever and exit without wandering. Buy Starlight only when it helps the next run or escape.
item.relatedItems: Bottle of Starlight, Gold, Timer Lever
item.cardSummary: The Backdoor finish line. Check the timer lever, collect what you need, and leave through the final door.

item.name: The Waiting Room (A-000)
item.accessCondition: Unlock the A-000 entrance from The Hotel's Rooms Entrance.
item.purpose: Begins the Rooms run and gives the player a light-source purchase before the dark office rooms.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Buy a Shakelight from the dispenser for Gold, then enter the first numbered room.
item.hazardsOrEntities: The main threat begins deeper in The Rooms, where visibility falls and the specialist entities appear.
item.survivalTip: Buy the backup light before leaving. The Rooms becomes much less forgiving once the office rooms turn dark.
item.cardSummary: The Rooms entry room. Spend a little Gold on a Shakelight before the long dark run begins.

item.name: Exit Rooms
item.route: Begins appearing after A-200 at intervals through The Rooms
item.accessCondition: Continue deep enough into The Rooms for an exit room to generate.
item.purpose: Offers an optional return to The Hotel before A-1000.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Find the EXIT door inside the room and hold it open to return to the Hotel Infirmary.
item.hazardsOrEntities: A-60 and A-120 can appear even though an Exit Room may not have a locker.
item.survivalTip: Use hiding spots in the previous room or a speed boost when an A-entity arrives. Leave if the run has already done its job.
item.cardSummary: The Rooms' optional escape hatch. It can save a run after A-200, but A-60 and A-120 may still pressure the exit.

item.name: A-1000
item.accessCondition: Reach the end of The Rooms instead of taking an earlier Exit Room.
item.purpose: Completes the long Rooms route and returns the group to The Hotel with the Starlight Jug.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Cross the Void Bridge, collect the Starlight Jug, and open the unlabelled exit door.
item.hazardsOrEntities: A-90 and the darkness of the final Rooms route can make the bridge approach dangerous.
item.survivalTip: Bring a reliable light and keep your inputs controlled when A-90 appears near the final stretch.
item.cardSummary: The true end of The Rooms. Cross the Void Bridge, take the Starlight Jug, and return to the Hotel.

item.name: The Small Courtyard
item.route: Outdoors start, tracked by meters and signs rather than numbered doors
item.accessCondition: Enter The Outdoors through the released Hotel route and its locked, vine-covered entrance.
item.purpose: Starts the Outdoors run and supplies the tools needed for the first gates and vines.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Open the gate, check the toolshed for Shears, and search the fountain area for the route forward.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Caws are associated with the fountain. Grass, vines, and open paths can expose the player to Outdoors hazards.
item.survivalTip: Take the Shears if they appear and use the signs to track progress instead of looking for fake door numbers.
item.cardSummary: The Outdoors starting area. Grab the toolshed's Shears and use the signs to find the first gate.

item.name: The Clearing
item.route: Around the middle of The Outdoors, tracked by meters and signs
item.accessCondition: Follow the gates and paths from The Small Courtyard.
item.purpose: Starts the Eyestalk chase and changes the route from open garden exploration to a forced escape.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Open the gate, follow the correct path through the clearing, and cross the outdoor obstacles.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Eyestalk, Groundskeeper, Snare, rivers, bridges, and blocked paths.
item.survivalTip: Keep a light ready and move decisively once Eyestalk forms. Use the route markers instead of stopping in open ground.
item.cardSummary: The Outdoors chase trigger. Once Eyestalk forms, follow the route and keep moving through the trees and bridges.

item.name: The Mill
item.route: Late Outdoors route, before The Hedge Maze
item.accessCondition: Reach the late garden path after The Clearing and its chase sequence.
item.purpose: Provides Grampy's Lotus service and another chance to collect tools before the final maze.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Give Grampy eight Lotus Petals to create a Lotus, and check the mill and toolshed for useful supplies.
item.hazardsOrEntities: The late Outdoors route can still include Monument, Surge, Snare, and other terrain hazards.
item.survivalTip: Search the mill before leaving, but do not linger if the route is active. Keep enough light for the maze ahead.
item.relatedItems: Lotus Petals, Lotus, Shears, Lantern, Compass
item.cardSummary: The Outdoors' late service stop. Visit Grampy for a Lotus and stock up before the final maze.

item.name: The Hedge Maze
item.route: Last 250m of The Outdoors, tracked by meters and signs
item.accessCondition: Reach the final Outdoors gate after The Mill.
item.purpose: Ends The Outdoors with a maze, Bramble chase, and World Lotus root puzzle.
item.puzzleOrLoot: Find and activate three guillotines to cut the roots blocking the exit.
item.hazardsOrEntities: Bramble, World Lotus roots, Snare, and the maze's limited sightlines.
item.survivalTip: Use the lamps and closets as landmarks. Stop moving when Bramble's light is on and keep a route back to safety.
item.cardSummary: The Outdoors finale. Find three guillotines, avoid Bramble, and cut through the World Lotus roots.
